notes.title: Chadgeon v1.2.2
notes.content:
Chadgeon v1.2.2

General Changes:

Multiplayer stability improvements

Account leveling up from XP increased from 20000 to 25000

Account leveling from games decreased from 5 to 3

Changed some spawns where people would normally sometimes spawn in walls

Ice Cream Ops:

Dying no longer scales base on amount of deaths. Instead its based off of the current wave number. This will allow players to be more aggressive early game.

- Premium gains: actually spawns premium gains if you are a client

notes.title: Chadgeon 1.2.0 The Golden Cone Bridge
notes.content:
Chadgeon v1.2.0

General Changes:

- New Augmentation System
- New base game map - Golden Cone Bridge
- Leaderboard! (Check out the stats menu)
- Literally Me Expansion Maps Can be unlocked with Chad Coins
- Megamind and Metroman Skins
- Loading screen changed slightly

Augmentations:

These are special pregame modifiers that can change your playstyle before a game starts. They can be unlocked by gaining bulk points by leveling up your player account level.

- Augment skill tree can be accessed in a lobby
- 14 Different augments to equip
- Players can only equip 3 augments at a time so they will have to specialize which ones they really want

Ability Changes:

- Feather Missiles:
  - No longer goes through walls
  - Can go through teammates
  - Color coated based on what flock they are apart of
- Pigeon Poo
  - No longer makes you immune to pigeon poo
  - You are immune to your own though
  - poo is slightly tinted a color based on flock
  - poo does not affect allies
  - poo is now slightly acidic dealing a small amount of damage while enemies are in it.
- Crit chance actually gives 30% crit chance, was originally 25% in the code
- lost illumination script actually gives +5% experience gain. it was originally just placebo effect because I didn't want to code it correctly

XP Rebalance:

Some upgrades and augments have a +5% xp bonus however cones are worth only 10 xp and the xp modifier is rounded so the 5% xp bonus does nothing with cones because it rounds to 0. Because of that I am doubling all xp gained in the game, from cones, KOing pigeons, and punching people. However I am also doubling level scaling so it won’t feel like anything has changed gameplaywise. That also means that I am doubling the xp requirement for leveling up your account so I apologize if some of you rank down a few levels :/

AI Changes:

The new augment system gives player pigeons more of an advantage over ai pigeons. Because of this, I am adding slight buffs to them to make them more challenging

- Chad +10% experience modifier
- Sigma +20% experience modifier
- All AI pigeons will start with 3 random augments.

notes.title: v1.1.0 Pigeon AI updates and Ops Rework
notes.content:
Literally Me Expansion DLC:
- 5 New Maps
  - Gotham
  - Wall Street
  - Pigeonland
  - Ryan Gosling 2042
  - Los Palomas Hermanos
Note: you will see these maps in the map selector but the expansion is currently in review by Steam as of this update. It should be available Friday next week

Base Game Updates:
- Controls show up when paused
- Can Select Upgrades by using Alpha or Keypad Numbers
- Cones spawn in batches every 2 seconds instead of a fixed rate
- Changed songs for some maps
- Minor changes to Yu Garden
- Default mode is back to Chad

Ice cream ops:
- Combat Experience multiplier reduced from 80% to 20%
- Goons no longer spawn randomly around the map during a wave
- Goons now spawn together in a huge wave
- Spawn location is set to a location furthest away from any allied pigeons or the Ice cream.
- Goon AI reworked (See AI Changes)

Supremacy Modes:
- Cone spawn rate scales with the amount of pigeons in game

AI Changes:
- All Pigeon Types spaz out less and move more smoothly
- Chads:
  - More aggressive while mewing
  - Will use feather missiles while fleeing enemies
  - Will take nearby cones when fleeing if they think they can overpower their enemy after eating it
- Sigmas:
  - More aggressive
  - But more careful in Ops mode
  - Don’t use mewing when they're on top of an enemy
  - Will use feather missiles while fleeing enemies
  - Will take nearby cones when fleeing if they think they can overpower their enemy after eating it
  - Will use pigeon poo offensively when engaging fights
  - Removed Sigma’s hidden 25% XP modifier. They no longer have any buffs compared to other pigeons… Only Skill.
- Goons (Ops)
  - The following 4 conditions will be preformed in order from highest priority to lowest.
  - First will look to fight any pigeon that gets close
  - Second will collect any cones that are nearby
  - Third will focus the main ice-cream cone if it is near
  - If none of the above are active the Goon will use 1 of 3 predesignated priorities that it will fall back on. Rush Ice-cream, Collect Cones, or Hunt Players.

Bug Fixes:
- Fixed host spectating bug when an AI dies of bleed
- Fixed freezing when music changes during a level
- Random map single player actually gives a random map not Ktown
